state:Andhra Pradesh.text: Andhra Pradesh has aggressively pursued artificial intelligence infrastructure investments, highlighted by major projects including a $15 billion Google AI data centre in Visakhapatnam and significant allotments to Reliance [R1349768b, R37f1fbdf]. The state is also advancing frontier technology education by approving India's first quantum and AI university campus in Amaravati and partnering with global firms like IBM to skill youth [R2d894836, R9fe15d9b]. Furthermore, the government has integrated AI across public services, deploying tools for urban flood forecasting, police monitoring, tax administration, and localized agricultural and tourism assistance [Rccf3ba89, Ra460605d, R6e71a6d9, R84d949ed, Rfffaf75c].

state:Bihar.text: Bihar has advanced artificial intelligence integration across multiple sectors, highlighted by proposed governance frameworks like the Bihar AI Policy 2026 and the establishment of the Bihar AI Mission [R4af400f2, Rb70e845b]. The state government has secured major investments and partnerships, including a ₹10,000 crore investment by CtrlS for data centres, an MoU with GFTN, and agreements with tech majors like Google and Microsoft for educational initiatives [Rd3f465ac, Reb7bfdb3, Rb70e845b, Rd71e810d]. Key applications span across modernizing school and higher education, training teachers and youth in AI, deploying AI tools for land-revenue, health tracking, and law enforcement, and establishing administrative tech infrastructure [Reb7bfdb3, Ra3ee576b, R6e6fb2b1, R129aede2, R2a1cfea2].

state:Gujarat.text: Gujarat has significantly advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major investments in infrastructure, governance, and educational initiatives [R65d2a417, Reff5d158, Ra6932da2]. The state introduced a Data Centre Policy targeting Green AI capacity alongside GPU-as-a-Service frameworks and massive hyperscale data centre projects [Re041bd74, Rd1b68bba, R43f4ae2b]. Simultaneously, the government integrated AI applications into public services, policing, and agriculture, while the High Court prohibited AI use in judicial decision-making following issues with generated case laws [Rbd9766bd, Rd78856c5, R3cc78d30, R28ccc09b, Ra310e3fc].

state:Karnataka.text: Karnataka has actively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through major initiatives spanning education, public service delivery, and infrastructure development. The state has integrated AI training and vocational subjects into government schools starting from early grades, alongside plans to establish a dedicated public AI university and multiple regional centers of excellence [R8176ca19, R3e7508f6, Rb77b1a7f, Rb7265c49]. Furthermore, the government has deployed AI for internal administrative tracking, agricultural monitoring, and citizen services, while simultaneously pursuing large-scale infrastructure projects like the proposed Bidadi AI township [Rf518fff6, R9d27904f, R9082b90f]. International partnerships and agreements with entities like Anthropic and ElevenLabs have additionally supported the state's goals in digital governance, voice AI adoption, and ethical regulatory frameworks [Rff273deb, R2c127a87, R9b3c768e].

state:Maharashtra.text: Maharashtra has aggressively advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem through comprehensive policy approvals, major infrastructure investments, and targeted governance initiatives [R562864e1, Rbff13ca0]. The state cabinet approved an Artificial Intelligence Policy with a ₹10,000 crore planned investment alongside major projects like the Tata AI Innovation City and various green data centre hubs [R562864e1, Rf8ceda95, Re0b416d1]. Furthermore, administrative adoption includes deploying Sarvam AI tools for government users, launching the MahaINDUS platform, and establishing dedicated multi-tier oversight committees and expert panels [R68fee1a0, R7ec03dda, R5afedf9c, R40c3cafc]. Public service integrations span law enforcement copilots, agricultural pilot projects, educational training mandates, and healthcare monitoring tools [R04592b70, Rcd594eaf, R481bc633, Rb96d46bb].

state:Odisha.text: Odisha is actively pursuing a tech-driven industrial transformation, marked by major investments and infrastructure projects in artificial intelligence and data centres [R657bba09]. Key initiatives include partnerships with companies like Sarvam AI and HCL Technologies to build sovereign AI infrastructure, compute facilities, and data centres in the state [R31b27cb7, Rdf1e1271, R3a36bb44]. The government has also integrated AI across various public administration and citizen services, deploying WhatsApp chatbots, automated traffic enforcement, and AI-enabled surveillance for enhanced governance and security [R478c8c67, R8a2dd09f, R128d452b]. Additionally, Odisha is overhauling its educational framework by introducing AI courses and skill development programmes in schools and higher education institutions [Rdb5da3c5, R7b1537aa, R7b9bb8d3].

state:Punjab.text: Punjab has pursued extensive artificial intelligence integration across education, governance, policing, and agriculture, highlighted by the state school board upgrading computer science curricula for classes VIII to XII to include AI [Rf4a0d422]. In the law enforcement sector, the Punjab Police has deployed AI-driven tools, voice recognition systems, and partnerships with IIT Ropar to track organized crime and dismantle international networks [R7333c0ad, R132d8a77]. Agricultural initiatives feature collaborations with IIT Ropar to deploy AI weather stations and smart advisories to improve farm productivity [R85a67327, R609b6fc5], while industrial plans include establishing an AI tower and positioning Mohali as a technology hub [R66f87829, R83b1fa54]. Concurrently, the judiciary has intervened in certain instances, with the Punjab and Haryana High Court restricting judicial officers and quashing automated notices reliant solely on AI tools [R8eacd504, R3d477cff].

state:Tamil Nadu.text: Tamil Nadu has rolled out extensive artificial intelligence initiatives across infrastructure, governance, and public services, highlighted by plans for a 1,000-acre AI city, a Sovereign AI Park established with Sarvam AI, and state-owned GPU clusters [R1b6cbab3, R472c3c1a, R8b2c535d]. The state budget emphasizes a comprehensive tech roadmap that includes developing a Tamil Large Language Model, expanding AI education and teacher training in schools, and introducing AI and machine learning trades in government ITIs [Rf24cede, R5742a9b1, R528f13c2, R47c1fd71]. In governance and public welfare, the government has launched WhatsApp chatbots like 'Namma Arasu' and 'NalamAI' for public service delivery and hospital appointments, alongside deploying AI systems for wildlife tracking, traffic violation detection, and fast-tracking building approvals [R576baa19, R494484b4, R63da60ab, Ra4ab0747, Rc4124c01].

state:Telangana.text: Telangana has actively pursued artificial intelligence integration across infrastructure, governance, and public services, anchored by initiatives like the Telangana AI Innovation Hub and major data center investments [Rd6f74125, R19bb1f80]. The state government has leveraged AI for revenue collection, traffic management, and emergency response, alongside targeted digital literacy and skilling programs for millions of students [R849548ed, Rce4536fa, R1819b706, R89c590e8]. Additionally, authorities have introduced regulatory guidelines and internal policies to govern responsible AI usage by government employees and commercial tax officers [R607d069a, Ra75d01a2].

state:Uttar Pradesh.text: Uttar Pradesh has advanced its artificial intelligence ecosystem by approving the UP Artificial Intelligence Mission alongside major investments in data infrastructure, a robotics and AI park in Greater Noida, and an AI city project in Lucknow [Rb1cbd4df, Rb312992b, Rbcca7384]. The state government has secured high-value memorandums of understanding for data compute hubs and launched targeted training initiatives, including mandatory AI courses in vocational schools and multi-million youth skill development programs [R212c0bcb, R1e320eca, R1a841461]. Furthermore, AI technologies are being increasingly integrated into public administration, ranging from exam monitoring and social welfare fraud detection to judicial transcription tools and institutional governance [Re0c4ff32, Rd1807ca7, R231ba3cf].

category:strategy_policy.text: Indian states are actively formulating comprehensive artificial intelligence policies, missions, and infrastructure strategies to position themselves as regional technology and deep-tech hubs [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, Rc68da9b5]. Significant initiatives include major financial allocations, such as Maharashtra's ₹10,000 crore investment policy and Chhattisgarh's ₹500 crore AI Mission [R562864e1, R7cc53f61], alongside targeted infrastructure projects like proposed AI cities, data centre policies, and specialized innovation hubs in states like Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, and Gujarat [R1b6cbab3, Rb322fa47, R398131aa]. Furthermore, states are heavily emphasizing workforce readiness and educational reforms, rolling out large-scale skilling programs for students and youth, and integrating artificial intelligence training into school and university curricula [R4af400f2, Rb312992b, R2c0df2e5]. Governments are also deploying artificial intelligence for public sector governance, administrative overhauls, agricultural monitoring, and revenue leak prevention [R45e372bd, R849548ed, R8f4114ad].

category:regulation_ethics.text: State governments and high courts have increasingly introduced regulations and committees to address ethical considerations, data privacy, and the risks of misuse associated with artificial intelligence. Notable actions include judicial restrictions on using AI for decision-making or judgment drafting, alongside directives addressing the risks of AI-generated or non-existent case law [Rbd9766bd, R3cc78d30]. States have also established committees and operational frameworks to govern responsible AI adoption in governance, manage data privacy, and mandate safety protocols for students and digital platforms [R9b3c768e, Raf4f7b8d, Rdc31ca32]. Furthermore, several jurisdictions have targeted emerging challenges such as deepfakes, copyright protections, and restrictions on unauthorized AI tools handling confidential government data [R371d634c, R607d069a, Refefa51b].

category:funding_budget.text: State governments have heavily prioritized funding and budget allocations for artificial intelligence initiatives, data infrastructure, and specialized skills missions [R7cc53f61, Rb312992b, R297b1b1d]. Major financial commitments include multi-crore state missions, substantial public-private partnerships, and large-scale industrial projects such as AI data centres and compute facilities [R44971ae6, Rd3f465ac, R657bba09]. Furthermore, regional authorities are directing investments toward sector-specific applications like agriculture, wildlife monitoring, education, and administrative governance [R68fee1a0, Radc0ac36, R311c8976, Rb20c0b99].

category:infrastructure.text: Indian states are aggressively expanding their digital infrastructure through significant investments in AI data centres, specialized tech parks, and computing hubs [R31b27cb7, R5b4a7a80, Rb1cbd4df]. Major projects include massive data centre campuses and sovereign AI parks led by state partnerships with industry giants in states like Andhra Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Odisha [R472c3c1a, R37f1fbdf, Rf8ceda95, R657bba09]. Additionally, regional governments are building foundational educational and research frameworks by establishing AI universities, centers of excellence, and specialized skilling programs [Rc16dddf8, Re78dfed2, R998e03d5].

category:partnership.text: State governments across India are actively engaging in partnerships and Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with global technology firms, research institutions, and industry bodies to accelerate artificial intelligence adoption. Major infrastructure investments and large-scale data center projects have been initiated through partnerships in states like Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, and Maharashtra [R5b4a7a80, R1349768b, Reff5d158, Re0b416d1]. Additionally, several states are focusing heavily on education, teacher training, and public service delivery by collaborating with companies such as Google, Microsoft, and ElevenLabs [Reb7bfdb3, R2889d124, Rff273deb, R3beb3201]. Other targeted initiatives include deploying AI for agricultural services, healthcare diagnostics, crime tracking, and multilingual governance [Rad868781, R6de84b70, R132d8a77, Rf88612cd].

category:deployment.text: Indian state governments are actively deploying artificial intelligence across public services, governance, and infrastructure [Rd731fc75, R8f4114ad]. Key initiatives include deploying AI-powered chatbots and voice portals for citizen services, agriculture, and multilingual support [Rccf3ba89, R3158dd4a, Ra61ec765], as well as integrating AI into policing, cybercrime investigations, and exam surveillance [R04592b70, R7333c0ad, Re0c4ff32]. States are also rolling out AI solutions for public health, education, transport management, and revenue monitoring [R27258895, R6e71a6d9, 576baa19, Ra460605d].

category:skilling.text: Numerous state governments are actively advancing AI skilling and digital education initiatives through targeted student training programs and curriculum integrations. For instance, states like Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Gujarat, and Telangana have rolled out large-scale programs targeting hundreds of thousands to millions of youth and students [R4af400f2, Rb312992b, Ra6932da2, R3bfd0d73]. Furthermore, states such as Punjab, Karnataka, and Tripura are systematically embedding artificial intelligence as a mainstream or vocational subject directly into school classrooms [Rf6319e99, R8176ca19, R3fff65a8]. To successfully deliver these educational initiatives, several states have forged strategic partnerships with major technology firms and institutions like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon for comprehensive teacher capacity building and digital infrastructure development [Reb7bfdb3, R2889d124, R998e03d5].

category:events_outreach.text: States across India have actively organized summits, tech expos, and conclaves focusing on artificial intelligence, digital governance, and emerging technologies [Rec3b838b, R14f8760f, R7d6b227a]. Significant actions include major international and regional summits such as the India AI Impact Summit, Bengaluru Tech Summit, and various state-level AI conferences aimed at boosting infrastructure, policy deployment, and stakeholder engagement [R84a7e58c, R4348031c, R6abb0164]. Additionally, numerous hackathons, workshops, and skill initiatives have been conducted to foster youth engagement, police surveillance innovation, and sectoral applications like health and agriculture [Ree4108bf, R28ccc09b, R12d4ab71, Rfd41fa83]. Events have also served as platforms for forging global partnerships, signing investment deals, and discussing responsible AI adoption [R84a7e58c, R2ae053d2, R8a719696].

state:Kerala.text: The state government has taken major steps to integrate artificial intelligence into public administration by launching an AI-led governance overhaul, rebranding its IT department to focus on AI and future technologies, and establishing twin AI Centres of Excellence [R8f4114ad, Rcaa18758, Ref58a154]. Significant initiatives span multiple sectors, including free AI-assisted competitive exam training for students, AI-driven public safety and surveillance tools deployed by the police, and technological frameworks for disaster and flood management [Rbf1453e2, R9147ba4b, R3391f5dc]. Additionally, administrative measures have addressed ethical and legal challenges through proposed copyright reforms and student-focused cyber safety protocols [Raf4f7b8d, R371d634c].

category:governance_body.text: Multiple state governments have established specialized governance structures, ministerial portfolios, and administrative committees to drive artificial intelligence integration across public administration [R6bbe2d82, R2dd69e13, R9b3c768e]. States like Kerala and Maharashtra have created dedicated AI departments or ministerial portfolios, alongside multi-tier panels to oversee policy implementation, coordinate cross-departmental projects, and frame regulatory frameworks [R5afedf9c, R6f0677ec, R7571f900]. Additionally, law enforcement and specialized sectors have formed dedicated AI cells and task forces to manage digital evidence, cybersecurity, land-revenue monitoring, and predictive governance [Ra1409382, Ra3ee576b, R6e827395]. Other administrative bodies, such as economic advisory councils and research organizations, are actively being deployed to foster public-private partnerships, data-driven strategies, and workforce readiness [Ra9ed9573, Rad75ff9b].

overall.text: Indian state governments have actively pursued artificial intelligence policy and infrastructure initiatives, with states like Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Tripura introducing dedicated AI policies and development frameworks [R6a6bee70, R562864e1, Rc68da9b5]. Major infrastructure investments are underway, including large-scale data center projects and AI cities planned in states such as Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, and West Bengal [R31b27cb7, R1b6cbab3, R5b4a7a80, Rf93d2652]. States are also integrating AI into education and public services through school tech training, specialized university hubs, and AI-driven governance or law enforcement tools [Rf6319e99, R2d894836, R04592b70, R7333c0ad]. Additionally, several regions have partnered with tech entities to advance regional language preservation, skill development, and digital health monitoring [Rad868781, R3158dd4a, R93ba67d7].

state:Assam.text: Assam has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, infrastructure, and public services by mapping numerous departmental proposals and launching a foundational AI roadmap [R416e5d33, R4203359c]. The state has commissioned its first government-owned GPU cluster, partnered with Google to build an AI Centre of Excellence, and introduced administrative tools like the ALISA platform in the Legislative Assembly [R936eb0aa, Red858166, Rdc7ff729]. Furthermore, Assam is integrating AI into education through teacher training programs with Google and UNICEF, deploying attendance systems in government schools, and expanding technology into healthcare, flood management, and wildlife conservation [R39b50ddb, R9c3a4d8c, R9c52da90, Ra093ebca].

state:Chhattisgarh.text: Chhattisgarh is actively advancing its digital and technology ecosystem through the Chhattisgarh AI Mission, backed by a Rs 500 crore investment over five years, alongside major infrastructure projects like a Rs 1,000 crore AI Data Center Park and large investments in data centers and digital transformation [R7cc53f61, Recb4eed4, R32faad8c]. The state has integrated artificial intelligence into diverse sectors, deploying AI-powered systems for wildlife conservation, rural road monitoring, and police investigations to uncover fraud and manage security [R8958cba0, Reb028d74, R1dec6260, R71e1d0ae]. Additionally, educational initiatives such as partnerships with Google to train teachers, coding and AI training modules for tribal and rural students, and specialized technical courses are driving future-ready skill development [R398fad0d, R1445ea1e, R5fcb3ecb].

state:Haryana.text: Haryana has advanced AI integration across governance, public services, education, and law enforcement, including initiatives like an AI sandbox, data centers, and digital IDs [R127f881c, R03b25e4d, Ra4378654]. The state is establishing AI hubs in Gurugram and Panchkula, collaborating with the World Bank, and deploying AI tools for healthcare, agriculture, policing, and financial fraud prevention [Ra6b5d331, R0a41f591, R2bca6acc, R770d942f, R2fc878d0]. Furthermore, educational reforms introduce AI and vocational curricula alongside teacher training programs in smart classrooms [Rcd5e27a7, R1cd067ec, Rfeb79591, Ree36c14f].

state:Himachal Pradesh.text: Himachal Pradesh is actively integrating artificial intelligence across education, governance, healthcare, and environmental management to enhance public service delivery [Re82f2564]. In the education sector, initiatives range from launching the 'Padhai with AI' learning app in Bilaspur and introducing AI courses and research partnerships at universities, to enrolling government teachers in digital skill baselines via 'The Teacher App' [Rb23a865a, R17bda009, R2a909d0d, R65824eab]. Governance and welfare measures feature AI-driven document verification, meeting management systems, and fraud prevention in the Himcare health scheme [R38e56e62, R1ba6a5ba, Rc3a3d3b4]. Additionally, the state employs AI for environmental and disaster risk applications, including forest restoration intelligence platforms, landslide vulnerability mapping, and urban resilience planning [Rd81af6f6, R26835c79, Re6fc0429, R98e84657].

state:Jharkhand.text: Jharkhand has advanced its digital economy by launching the Jharkhand AI Policy 2026, which targets significant investments, job creation, and modernized public governance [Rb9553546, R4b4e0b34]. The state government has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, including healthcare partnerships with Google, AI smart classes in government schools, and specialized police and administrative task forces [Rb7cd9ee5, R95bbe8d6, R75cf7a06, R25c27df1]. Furthermore, infrastructure developments feature advanced judicial data centers, AI training programs for rural and tribal youth, and technology labs established under the IndiaAI Mission [R19745493, R8022329a, Re675872a].

state:Madhya Pradesh.text: Madhya Pradesh has increasingly integrated artificial intelligence across public administration, governance, and infrastructure development, highlighted by large investments and technological partnerships with entities like Google Cloud [R6473839f, R005881fc]. Significant applications include AI-driven surveillance and crowd management systems for major events like Simhastha 2028, as well as smart tools deployed for monitoring public procurement anomalies and security [R12d4ab71, R37a735c1, R085470af]. Additionally, the state is advancing regional tech capabilities through initiatives focused on data centers, semiconductor chip packaging, and education sector training [Rac12a0cd, R4df0843d, R5d3f24d3].

state:Manipur.text: The state of Manipur has actively integrated artificial intelligence across governance, education, and public sector domains, highlighted by initiatives in digital governance, cybersecurity, and tribal welfare [R8e91e0e8, Rdc31ca32, Re9f95033]. Significant partnerships include an MoU with the Digital India BHASHINI Division to expand multilingual AI, as well as collaborations with Microsoft [Rad868781, Rdc31ca32]. Furthermore, academic and institutional efforts have advanced AI applications through workshops, research colloquiums, and the launch of translation tools like the 'Ishaan' app [R49d826c3, R546f135d, R13590541]. Other notable developments involve exploring AI to curb wildlife trafficking and focusing on digital tourism [R7249ca9d, R3413274d].

state:Meghalaya.text: Meghalaya is actively integrating artificial intelligence across education, governance, and rural development, highlighted by initiatives like introducing AI-enabled learning in schools and showcasing its GeoAI-powered edGrid model [R24be49c9, R73c7e0d9]. The state is expanding its technology infrastructure by drafting a new IT policy focused on AI and global capability centres, proposing an AI Centre of Excellence, and expanding its tech parks [R9625f972, Rf277c3a3, R1d376337]. Furthermore, the government is leveraging AI for public services, agriculture, and healthcare, utilizing data-driven systems to improve maternal health and deploy machine learning for landslide mapping [R84a1eeb7, Rfbdf90e5, Rf1f88f85].

state:Tripura.text: Tripura has positioned itself at the forefront of regional AI policy by initiating India's first state-level AI policy and partnering with Google India and IIT Kharagpur to build a comprehensive artificial intelligence ecosystem [Rc68da9b5, R33168f25, R9435f1d2]. The state government has integrated artificial intelligence across multiple sectors, launching the 'AI Skill Initiative' for government school students, an AI-powered school monitoring system, and introducing robotics and VR labs in schools [R3fff65a8, R20047d48, R311a6da8]. Additionally, leadership has driven technology adoption into public services and healthcare through agreements for AI X-ray machines, traffic management enhancements, and targeted workforce training initiatives [R8edb04a8, R2235629e, Rb70cb3d9].

state:Uttarakhand.text: Uttarakhand has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives across governance, education, and conservation through various policy actions and summits. The state government made AI education mandatory across 45 universities to train thousands of youth annually and partnered on capacity building for teachers [Rcea6d545, Rb0eb9126]. Additionally, administrative measures integrated artificial intelligence into revenue mechanisms, cyber crime helplines, and wildlife and forest monitoring systems [Recb1f69d, R549f779d, R994e0e10, R82962675].

state:West Bengal.text: West Bengal is actively integrating artificial intelligence across industrial policies, education, and public infrastructure, supported by major projects like the Silicon Valley initiative and the draft industrial policy focusing on AI and data centres [Rf93d2652, R0c1ea7de, R90ad9af5]. The state has launched several education and workforce development initiatives, including Oracle partnerships to train 15,000 students and school modernisation pushes introducing AI curricula [Rde3629a0, Rac4428c1]. Furthermore, law enforcement and governance have seen technological upgrades through the establishment of a police AI cell, the Samarth app for investigations, and AI-powered public helplines [R6e827395, R904a08ab, R08e415eb]. Civic services and urban infrastructure are also leveraging AI to improve areas such as property tax, bridge safety, and waterlogging management [Rebcdd9ec].

state:Rajasthan.text: Rajasthan has advanced its artificial intelligence initiatives through policy approvals like the AI-ML Policy 2026 and public skill-building programs such as the Official AI Foundational Course [R6a6bee70, R2c694631]. The state government and various departments have increasingly integrated AI applications into agriculture, healthcare, policing, and public grievance redressal, exemplified by partnerships with Wadhwani AI, digital crop surveys, and AI-enabled traffic and surveillance systems [R6de84b70, Red667749, R22f05974, Rd7e6b721]. Additionally, governance discussions and declarations have highlighted the role of technology and automated tools across sectors in the region [Rcfaf8a9a, R9f4268d3].
